CeraVe Hydrating Skin Polish – Gentle Exfoliation for Smooth, Glowing Skin

Give your skin the care it deserves with CeraVe Hydrating Skin Polish, a gentle exfoliating formula designed to remove dead skin cells, improve texture, and restore your skin’s natural glow. This hydrating skin polish helps reveal softer, smoother and brighter-looking skin.

Key Benefits

✔ Gentle exfoliation for smoother skin texture
✔ Helps remove dead skin & impurities
✔ Deep hydration for soft, healthy-looking skin
✔ Supports a brighter, radiant complexion
✔ Helps improve uneven-looking skin tone
✔ Easy addition to your skincare routine

How To Use

1. Apply a small amount to clean, damp skin.
2. Gently massage in circular motions for 1–2 minutes.
3. Rinse thoroughly with water.
4. Use 2–3 times weekly for best results.
